subject: I wasn't going to share this secret preset
preview_text: Made something extra for you. A custom EQ setting that makes your phone sound like a $1000 speaker. It's yours.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was tweaking the EQ for my own playlist last night and stumbled onto something. It was an accident, really. A combination of settings that made my phone's speakers do something they've never done before.

The bass wasn't just boosted—it was clean and deep, like a subwoofer. The highs were crisp without being tinny. The whole soundstage just... opened up. I saved it as 'Secret Sauce' on my phone and wasn't planning to release it. It felt like my personal hack. But then I thought, if you've stuck with the app this long, you deserve the good stuff.

It's loaded into your app right now. Open the Equalizer, scroll past the genre presets (Pop, Rock, etc.), and you'll find a new one called 'Halbert's Mix'. That's it. No premium paywall, no unlock required. It works with the free version. It's my thank-you for being a user.

Tap the button, open the app, and flip to that preset. Play your favorite song. You'll hear the difference in the first 10 seconds. P.S. This preset works shockingly well for podcasts and movies too—suddenly every whisper is clear and every explosion has weight.
P.P.S. If you love it and want to tweak it further (maybe add a little more bass or adjust the mids), that's where Premium's advanced EQ controls come in. But the gift itself is 100% free.
